browser.description: Chrome browser launch and lifecycle settings

headless.description: Whether to run Chrome in headless mode

viewport.description: Window size: "WIDTHxHEIGHT" (e.g. 1280x720), "maximized" (falls back to 1920x1080 in headless), or empty for Chrome default

display.description: Linux only: fallback DISPLAY value when unset (e.g. ":0"). WSLg is auto-detected

extraArgs.description: Extra command-line flags passed to Chrome

browserUrl.description: Direct CDP HTTP URL of an existing Chrome instance (skips launching or closing Chrome)

lazyStart.description: Delay launching Chrome until the first browser tool call (default true)

idleTimeout.description: Auto-close idle browser/daemon after duration with unit (e.g. "30m", "1h", "300s") or "never" / 0 to never auto-close

flags.description: Additional CLI flags forwarded to chrome-devtools-mcp

backgroundNewPages.description: When true, supply background: true on new_page calls that omit background. Explicit background arguments always win

batchActions.description: Enable bounded compound batch execution (batch / run_actions)

evaluateScript.description: Rewrite inline evaluate_script functions so page stack traces hide pptr: and MCP install paths. Default true

sourceUrl.description: Source URL token shown in rewritten evaluate_script stack traces (single non-whitespace token)

disable_update_check.description: Disable CLI update networking and cached update/announcement reminders
